title: Germany news: Parties debate who should succeed President Steinmeier, with several women under discussion
summary: Germany's political parties are weighing possible successors to President Frank-Walter Steinmeier, with no candidate agreed yet. Meanwhile, a poll suggests most Germans are giving Halloween a miss…

image.caption: Germany's president is mostly a ceremonial role, limited to two terms [FILE September 2026]Image: Uli Deck/dpa/picture alliance

items: The presidential term ends in January, but parties are already talking about his successor.
A YouGov poll finds 74% of Germans unlikely to celebrate Halloween
Half of 18- to 24-year-olds plan to celebrate, with older people less keen
Germany is set to elect a successor to Frank-Walter Steinmeier on January 30

Merz eyes fighter jet cooperation with Japan

blocks.caption: The leaders discussed closer industrial and defense ties, including possible cooperation on fighter jet developmentImage: Issei Kato/REUTERS

blocks.text: Geman Chancellor Friedrich Merz said Germany and Japan would explore jointly developing a fighter jet as they seek closer industrial ties.

"We also want to explore whether cooperation in fighter aircraft construction is possible," Merz said after meeting Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi in Tokyo. Takaichi also backed closer defense cooperation.
Britain invited Germany earlier this month to join the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), following the collapse of the rival German-French-Spanish Future Combat Air System project.
Britain, Japan and Italy are developing a sixth-generation fighter jet under GCAP, aiming to have it operational by 2035.
